said.q: Turning to a light, lucid style and favouring plein-air painting, Cross found his motifs on his many travels to the coast of Provence, Umbria and Venice, where this particular work was painted in situ. Beneath the arch of a bridge, this watercolour shows two boats drifting on the rippling waters of the Venetian lagoon.
